method: Run in an rsync copy of the envoi/slice-15-release working tree without .env.local, with a cp -cR copy of node_modules and DATABASE_URL removed. Each definition in s15-focus-mutation-defs.json is applied alone by exact text replacement, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256. Vitest definitions: the named row must fail on an AssertionError and the whole file pass on rerun; other failing rows are recorded. Command definitions: the command must exit non-zero with the needle in its output, the control command must pass under the same mutation, and the command must pass on rerun.

results.mutation: Focus moves even when no action ran.
results.test: does nothing when no action ran
results.group: focus returns to the button after its action
results.error: AssertionError: expected { focus: [Function focus] } to be null

results.mutation: Focus moves while the action is still running.
results.test: does nothing while the action is still running
results.group: focus returns to the button after its action
results.error: AssertionError: expected { focus: [Function focus] } to be null

results.mutation: Focus is taken from a control the user moved to.
results.test: leaves focus the user moved to another control
results.group: focus returns to the button after its action
results.error: AssertionError: expected { focus: [Function focus] } to be null

results.mutation: No focused element is treated as focus the user placed.
results.test: returns focus to the button when the action ends with no focused element
results.group: focus returns to the button after its action
results.error: AssertionError: expected null to be { focus: [Function focus] } // Object.is equality

results.mutation: Nothing is focused when focus fell to the body.
results.test: returns focus to the button when the action ends with focus on the page body
results.group: focus returns to the button after its action
results.error: AssertionError: expected null to be { focus: [Function focus] } // Object.is equality
other_failing_rows: returns focus to the button when the action ends with no focused element
